## What the theme gives each component

> Derived from `packages/mui/theme/components.mjs` — **the values live there**; this is the index, so
> you do not have to read it whole. With the theme mounted (`ThemeProvider` + `CssBaseline`), the
> row's MUI component already comes out with Neo styling: what follows is what the theme adds.

**alert** → `MuiAlert` (46 lines of the theme)
- dresses: `message` · `standardError` · `standardInfo` · `standardSuccess` · `standardWarning`
- with no props it comes out with: `iconMapping: alertIconMapping`
- tokens: `--neo`* · `--text`*
- **only dressed in `variant="standard"`** — `filled` and `outlined` falls back to MUI's styling, without error or warning

**badge** → `MuiBadge` (28 lines of the theme)
- dresses: `badge` · `dot` · `root`
- tokens: `--fill`* · `--neo`* · `--text`*

**button** → `MuiButton` (139 lines of the theme)
- dresses: `root`
- with no props it comes out with: `disableElevation: true, variant: 'contained', disableFocusRipple: true`
- responds to: `data-surface`
- tokens: `--border`* · `--fill`* · `--neo`*

**button-icon** → `MuiIconButton` (112 lines of the theme)
- dresses: `root`
- with no props it comes out with: `disableFocusRipple: true`
- responds to: `data-surface`
- tokens: `--border`* · `--fill`* · `--icon`* · `--neo`*

**checkbox** → `MuiCheckbox` (29 lines of the theme)
- dresses: `root`
- with no props it comes out with: `disableRipple: true, checkedIcon: _h(CheckboxCheckedIcon), indeterminateIcon: _h(CheckboxIndeterminateIcon)`
- tokens: `--border`* · `--fill`* · `--icon`* · `--neo`* · `--text`*

**chips** → `MuiChip` (155 lines of the theme)
- dresses: `root`
- with no props it comes out with: `deleteIcon: _h(ChipCloseIcon)`
- responds to: `data-selected` · `data-tone`
- tokens: `--border`* · `--fill`* · `--icon`* · `--neo`* · `--text`*

**chips-group** → `MuiRadioGroup` **has no block of its own, and that is correct**: in MUI it is a composite
whose root is `FormControl`. Its styling lives in `MuiFormGroup`, which is what lets `Select` and
`Autocomplete` inherit the same chrome without going through `TextField`.

**combobox** → `MuiAutocomplete` (181 lines of the theme)
- dresses: `clearIndicator` · `inputRoot` · `listbox` · `option` · `paper` · `popupIndicator`
- with no props it comes out with: `popupIcon: _h(SelectChevronIcon), includeInputInList: true`
- tokens: `--border`* · `--fill`* · `--icon`* · `--neo`* · `--surface`* · `--text`*

**link** → `MuiLink` (37 lines of the theme)
- dresses: `root`
- with no props it comes out with: `underline: 'always', color: 'inherit'`
- tokens: `--neo`* · `--text`*

**menu** → `MuiMenu` (26 lines of the theme)
- dresses: `paper`
- with no props it comes out with: `anchorOrigin: { vertical: 'bottom', horizontal: 'left'`
- tokens: `--border`* · `--neo`* · `--surface`*

**modal-dialog** → `MuiDialog` (373 lines of the theme)
- dresses: `paper`
- exposes (a local property of the component, NOT a system token): `--neo-dialog-actions-align` · `--neo-dialog-actions-dir` · `--neo-dialog-actions-flex` · `--neo-dialog-actions-justify` · `--neo-dialog-actions-min` · `--neo-dialog-actions-width` · `--neo-dialog-close-gutter` · `--neo-dialog-content-bottom` · `--neo-dialog-content-top` · `--neo-dialog-gutter`
- responds to: `data-scroll` · `data-type`
- tokens: `--border`* · `--fill`* · `--neo`* · `--surface`* · `--text`*

**text-field** → `MuiTextField` **has no block of its own, and that is correct**: in MUI it is a composite
whose root is `FormControl`. Its styling lives in `MuiOutlinedInput`, which is what lets `Select` and
`Autocomplete` inherit the same chrome without going through `TextField`.

**toggle** → `MuiSwitch` (29 lines of the theme)
- dresses: `root` · `switchBase` · `thumb` · `track`
- with no props it comes out with: `disableRipple: true`
- tokens: `--border`* · `--fill`* · `--neo`*

**tooltip** → `MuiTooltip` (83 lines of the theme)
- dresses: `arrow` · `popper` · `tooltip`
- with no props it comes out with: `arrow: true, slotProps: { popper: { modifiers: [{ name: 'offset', options: { offset: [0, 4]`
- tokens: `--fill`* · `--neo`* · `--text`*

> **Text fields are only dressed in the `outlined` variant** (MUI's default, and the
> master's). `variant="filled"` and `variant="standard"` render another MUI component that the theme does not dress: the control falls outside the system,
> without error or warning. Do not use them.

## Each master property, and how to request it in React

> **The 149 properties the masters expose, measured, with how each one arrives.** A Figma master
> and a React component do not share a vocabulary, and the differences are not defects: Figma has
> no arrays, so it repeats `option-1` … `option-10` where React takes a list; it has no DOM
> states, so it draws `state=hover` as a variant; and it separates a part's presence from its
> text because one property cannot be both. This table says, for each one, what shape it takes on
> this side.
>
> A **⚠️ gap** is the only real defect: the property exists in the master and there is no way to
> request it. Each one is tracked.

Notes:
- **aspect-ratio** — CSS aspect-ratio; default 16:9
- **badge** — number/dot = Badge · badge/state = Chip variant="status"
- **banner** — composition with a cover slot
- **chips** — the BASE variant of MuiChip (the interactive chip); `tag` and the `badge` status are the other two on the same slot
- **chips-group** — single = RadioGroup, a FormGroup with role=radiogroup whose options are native radios drawn as chips · multiple = the same FormGroup with role=group and toggle chips inside
- **empty-state** — composition of illustration, text and action
- **modal-dialog** — fixed widths per size (343/600/900/1200), not the MUI maxWidth — the 343 of `xs` comes from the master
- **modal-fullscreen** — fullScreen
- **tabs** — the group has variants by count (2–6); in code that is `tabs.length`. Each tab draws its own rail: the native MUI indicator is turned off
- **tag** — variant="tag"
